title: Read factorial recursion and a trampoline loop
description: You compare the supplied recursive functions with deferred calls driven by a loop.

steps.description: You read factorial with multiplication after the recursive call and a second version carrying an accumulator. Both supplied calls for 10 print 3628800.
You inspect two counters with identical recursive structure, each returning its depth argument. Both print 20; the recorded environment reports recursion limit 5000.

steps.question: When does the trampoline loop stop calling its current result?
steps.answer: It stops when result is no longer callable, then returns that value.

steps.description: You return a lambda from each unfinished fact_trampoline call and let the loop invoke successive deferred calls. The supplied output includes trampoline factorial of 10 as 3628800; it contains no printed factorial-of-100 result.
